landing.footer: Build and launch a profitable business

hero.title: Say it. See it.
hero.lead: One sentence is enough. iVision makes the motion design video or the visual, in your colours, in the format each network needs.

imprint.text: Paste your website’s link. iVision reads its colours, fonts, logo and tone, and uses them right away in everything it makes.
imprint.noSite: No website? Write “in blue and gold” in your request, that’s enough.

stencil.text: Like a video or a poster? Add it. iVision picks up its cuts, its movements and its layout, with your texts, your images and your music.

liveEdit.text: Click a text: the video jumps to the moment it appears and changes while you type. Don’t like a photo? Replace it in one click.
liveEdit.screen: Example of a video being edited in iVision’s editor

workshops.text: One conversation makes visuals, another makes videos. Each keeps its own settings and history.

image.name: Visuals
image.text: Posters, posts, stories, banners: laid out to the millimetre and checked by eye before they reach you.

video.name: Videos
video.text: From 6 to 60 seconds, with royalty-free music and sound effects. Or your own talking video, edited for you.

creativity.text: Choose how powerful the model that creates is. At the bottom, a light, fast model. At the top, the most powerful one. The price follows the level.

low.name: Low
low.text: A light model composes your visual: fast, at the base price.

medium.name: Medium
medium.text: An intermediate model: the right balance, recommended.

high.name: High
high.text: An advanced model: sharper, bolder compositions.

ultra.name: Ultra
ultra.text: The most powerful model, for a true authored creation.

montage.text: Import a video of yourself talking. iVision cuts the silences and hesitations, adds subtitles and shows on screen what you say. Ready to post.
montage.screen: Example of a talking video being edited

welcome.title: Welcome to iVision
welcome.body: Here you create videos and images to promote your business. You write what you want, iVision makes it.

tabs.title: Video or image?
tabs.body: Choose here what you want to create: a video, or an image to post.

choices.title: Two ways to make a video
choices.body: Describe it and I create it as an animation. Or add the video where you talk, and I edit it for you.

composer.title: Write the way you talk
composer.body: For example: “a video for our back-to-school sale”. Then press the arrow.

brand.title: Your colours, if you like
brand.body: Paste your website address: I take your logo, colours and fonts, and I can create your brand guidelines. It is optional: without a website, I pick colours that work well.

creativity.title: More or less daring
creativity.body: Choose the creativity level. Creating is free: only the HD export without the mark is paid, and its price shows right next to it.

history.title: Everything you created
history.body: Your creations stay here. Click one to see it again or change it.

credits.title: Your wallet
credits.body: Creating is free and marked “Made with iVision”. The HD export without the mark is paid from your IDEM wallet, and everything is included with iVision Creator (2,000 F/month).

done.title: Your turn!
done.body: Write your first request. You can see this guide again anytime with “See the guide again”.

say.title: Something to change?
say.body: Just write it: “no music”, “change the title”, “add an intro”. I’ll take care of it.

edit.title: Or change it yourself
edit.body: The “Edit” button opens a page to adjust everything by clicking.

download.title: Download it
download.body: When you like it, download it to post on your social networks.

preview.title: Your video
preview.body: It updates with every change. Press play to watch it again.

timeline.title: The video timeline
timeline.body: Each dot is an item that appears on screen. Tap one to jump to it.

tabs.title: Everything is set here
tabs.body: What appears, captions, start and end, music and format.

save.title: Nothing to save
save.body: Your changes save on their own. When it’s ready, download the video.

charter.title: My brand guidelines
charter.failed: The brand guidelines could not be created.
charter.offer: Your brand guidelines: your logo, colours, fonts and how to use them, as pages you can read here.
charter.refused: Your IDEM wallet is not enough for these guidelines: top it up, then try again.
